def guard(event,args):
    if event.startswith("socket.") or event in {"subprocess.Popen","os.system","os.posix_spawn","os.fork"}:
        raise RuntimeError("Forbidden external effect: "+event)

        raise RuntimeError("Forbidden environment file")

        raise RuntimeError("Forbidden database/container import")

import ast,inspect,socket,urllib.request,urllib.parse
import pytest
p=pathlib.Path("tests/test_vk_media_upload_destination.py").resolve()
helper=types.ModuleType("vk_upload_adjacent_loader")
helper.__file__=str(p)
exec(compile(p.read_text(),str(p),"exec"),helper.__dict__)
outbound_network=helper._load_helpers()["outbound_network"]

exec(compile(pathlib.Path("src/core/telegram_network.py").read_text(),"src/core/telegram_network.py","exec"),telegram_network.__dict__)
def forbidden_storage(*args,**kwargs):
    raise AssertionError("Unexpected real storage access")
media_delivery=types.ModuleType("vk_adjacent_media")
media_delivery.__dict__.update({"outbound_network":outbound_network,"urljoin":urllib.parse.urljoin,"load_media_file":forbidden_storage})
media_tree=ast.parse(pathlib.Path("src/services/social_posts/media_delivery.py").read_text())
selected=[ast.ImportFrom(module="__future__",names=[ast.alias(name="annotations")],level=0)]
selected.extend(n for n in media_tree.body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name in {"_fetch_public_media","_media_asset_file"} or isinstance(n,ast.Assign) and any(isinstance(t,ast.Name) and t.id in {"_MAX_EXTERNAL_MEDIA_BYTES","_MAX_EXTERNAL_MEDIA_REQUESTS","_EXTERNAL_MEDIA_HEADERS"} for t in n.targets))
exec(compile(ast.fix_missing_locations(ast.Module(body=selected,type_ignores=[])),"src/services/social_posts/media_delivery.py","exec"),media_delivery.__dict__)
selection={
"tests/test_outbound_network.py":None,

"tests/test_contact_intelligence_ssrf.py":{"test_pinned_fetch_connects_to_validated_ip_not_rebound_hostname","test_pinned_fetch_rejects_non_public_dns_answers","test_pinned_fetch_rejects_mixed_public_and_private_dns","test_pinned_fetch_rechecks_dns_and_rejects_rebinding","test_https_pinned_fetch_uses_ip_with_original_host_sni","test_ipv6_pinned_fetch_brackets_host_header","test_pinned_fetch_obeys_size_cap_and_releases_pool_on_read_error"},
}
excluded={"test_external_media_keeps_local_storage","test_runtime_facade_uses_pinned_fetch"}
executed=[]
for path,names in selection.items():
    tree=ast.parse(pathlib.Path(path).read_text())
    nodes=[n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n,(ast.ClassDef,ast.Assign)) or isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and (not n.name.startswith("test_") or (names is None or n.name in names) and n.name not in excluded)]
    namespace={"pytest":pytest,"socket":socket,"urllib":urllib,"outbound_network":outbound_network,"telegram_network":telegram_network,"media_delivery":media_delivery}
    exec(compile(ast.fix_missing_locations(ast.Module(body=nodes,type_ignores=[])),path,"exec"),namespace)
    for name,function in list(namespace.items()):
        if not name.startswith("test_") or not callable(function):continue
        cases=[{}]
        for mark in getattr(function,"pytestmark",[]):
            assert mark.name=="parametrize",mark.name
            arguments=mark.args[0]
            keys=[v.strip() for v in arguments.split(",")] if isinstance(arguments,str) else list(arguments)
            cases=[dict(zip(keys,[value] if len(keys)==1 else value)) for value in mark.args[1]]
        for index,arguments in enumerate(cases):
            monkeypatch=pytest.MonkeyPatch()
            try:
                function(monkeypatch=monkeypatch,**arguments)
            finally:
                monkeypatch.undo()
            executed.append(path+"::"+name+"["+str(index)+"]")
assert len(executed)==24,executed
print(json.dumps({"passed":len(executed),"cases":executed,"scope":"AST-selected unchanged assertions; real pure network core; no app/facade/database imports; mocked DNS/transports; no pytest collection/plugins"}),flush=True)
